questions.question: It was only when I had finished my homework that I realized I had left my phone charger at home. By the time I arrived at my friend's house, they had already gone to bed.
options: I had forgotten to bring my charger
By the time I got there, my friends were asleep
It was only when I finished my homework that I realized...
My friends went to bed as soon as I arrived
questions.answer: I had forgotten to bring my charger

questions.question: Unless the project is completed by the end of the month, we will have to postpone its implementation until next year.
options: If the project isn't finished on time
In case the deadline isn't met
Provided that the project is finished on schedule
Once the project has been completed
questions.answer: Unless the project is completed by the end of the month

questions.question: What I was saying, however, was that I had already decided to attend the conference.
options: I meant to say that I wouldn't be going
However, what I actually said was...
In fact, my intention was to decline the invitation
But what I really meant was...
questions.answer: What I was saying, however, was that I had already decided to attend the conference

questions.question: The manager suggested that we should consider the long-term implications of our actions before making a decision.
options: He recommended that we think about the short-term consequences
It was his opinion that we should focus on the immediate effects
The manager advised us to ignore the potential outcomes
He proposed that we examine the medium-term repercussions
questions.answer: The manager suggested that we should consider the long-term implications of our actions

questions.question: It is essential, however, that you understand the nuances of the contract before signing it.
options: You must be aware of all the details
It's crucial to read between the lines
However, it's not necessary to comprehend the subtleties
You should only sign if you agree with everything
questions.answer: It is essential, however, that you understand the nuances of the contract
